You can see a fridge. Classic TextWorld. You see an oven. You bend down to tie your shoe. When you stand up, you notice a table! The table is massive. On the table you make out a cookbook. Classic TextWorld. You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a counter. The counter is vast. On the counter you can see a banana and a red hot pepper. You see a stove. The stove is conventional. But there isn't a thing on it.



There is a sliced fried yellow potato, a raw red potato and a diced roasted red onion on the floor.
inventory: You are carrying: a chopped roasted block of cheese and a knife.
